bio.text: Donny Olson (listed by the Legislature as Donald Olson) has served in the Alaska Senate for District T since 2001.
Olson's legislative biography says Olson was born in Nome on June 18, 1953, and is a lifelong Alaskan from Golovin.

It lists a B.A. in chemistry from the University of Minnesota Duluth and an M.D. from Oral Roberts School of Medicine, and describes Olson's occupations as doctor, pilot, reindeer herder and businessman.
